name: Analytic 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing for Tomography
aliases: 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing for Tomographic Reconstruction
definition: A tomographic reconstruction model that calculates line integrals of 3D anisotropic Gaussians analytically along rays, avoiding local affine approximations used in splatting-based methods. It is designed for cylindrical detector arrangements (PET) requiring arc correction and non-uniform bin spacing.
